extension.name: LibraryBridge
extension.description: Reviews LibraryBridge commands that relocate or restore Steam Proton data, remove retained originals, record evidence, or write Lutris plans and import state.
safer_alternatives: Review the matching --dry-run or -n plan before applying changes. Inspect evidence without --record; evidence recording is not a dry run.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge repair
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge repairs that copy Proton compatdata, retain the original, and change the Steam library path.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge fix with --dry-run and review the complete plan first.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge repair undo
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge undo operations that restore Proton compatdata to the Steam library and remove its routing link.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge undo with --dry-run and review the restore plan first.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge backup removal
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge backup cleanup that permanently removes retained original compatdata after its recovery checks.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge backup with --dry-run and confirm the original is recoverable.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge Lutris import
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge Lutris imports that write selected game definitions and import records into Lutris state.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge lutris import with --dry-run and review the selected games first.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge evidence recording
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge evidence recording that writes a user's launch or save result for a library. The upstream evidence command still records evidence with -n or --dry-run.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge evidence <id> without --record to inspect the current evidence.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge Lutris plan creation
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge Lutris plan creation that writes a reviewable import plan to the requested output path.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge lutris plan with --dry-run and review the proposed games first.

permissions.label: LibraryBridge Lutris import record removal
permissions.description: Reviews LibraryBridge Lutris forget operations that remove the tool's record of an imported game.
safer_guidance: Run librarybridge lutris forget with --dry-run before removing the import record.
